dialogue.speaker: Android employee 1
dialogue.text: … this is the very latest model, the LT600.  This is the top of the range household assistant.  It cooks 10,000 different dishes, speaks 200 languages and dialects  and handles the kids' homework from elementary school up to university level.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Wow,  honey, it looks amazing… This is exactly what we need…

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: How much did you say it costs?

dialogue.speaker: Android employee 1
dialogue.text: At the moment we're doing a special promotion on this entire range at $7999, with a 48-months interest free credit.  And it comes with a two-year warranty for parts and labor.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: We'll take it.

dialogue.speaker: Android employee 1
dialogue.text: An excellent choice, sir.  If you'll just follow me, we'll process the order.

dialogue.speaker: Mother
dialogue.text: Come on, Zoe. Let’s go.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: We're still gonna have to finance it,  I can't pay  for that cash.

dialogue.speaker: Android employee 2
dialogue.text: Good afternoon!  Can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Please, we're looking for a little  help around the house.

dialogue.speaker: Android employee 2
dialogue.text: The MP500 is a very basic model, it pretty much handles all the chores around the house.  I can show you another model.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Android employee 2
dialogue.text: It does absolutely all the work around the house: painting, plumbing, gardening, repairs.  At night, it switches to surveillance mode and contacts emergency services if there’s a break-in, or if it detects smoke.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how much is that one over there?

dialogue.speaker: Android employee 2
dialogue.text: The MP800 is slightly more expensive, but it has many other functions.  Come along and I'll show you.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Slightly more expensive and lots of functions... I don't like this guy. I'm not spending a penny over four.  That's it.  Okay?  Forget about it.

dialogue.speaker: Human employee
dialogue.text: Thank you, and we're good.

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: Can I go pick it up?

dialogue.speaker: Human employee
dialogue.text: Yeah, right back here.  There it is. It was a bit difficult getting it back in working order.  It was really messed up… What did you say happened to it again?

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: Huh, A car hit it…  Stupid accident…

dialogue.speaker: Human employee
dialogue.text: Oh,  I see…  Anyway, it's as good as new now… Except that we had to reset it.  Meaning we had to wipe its memory.  Hope you don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: That'll be fine.

dialogue.speaker: Human employee
dialogue.text: Okay,  did you give it a name?

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: My daughter did…

dialogue.speaker: Human employee
dialogue.text: AX400, register your name.

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: Kara.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: My name is Kara.

input.chapter_briefing: Carl Manfred's mansion in Detroit, morning. Carl, a famous elderly painter who uses a wheelchair, is cared for by his android, Markus. The grand house is full of art, a piano, a chess set and books. Carl is warm, sharp and blunt, treats Markus as more than a machine and invites him to paint for the first time. His son Leo, a resentful drug user, sometimes turns up asking for money. Stakes: Carl's well-being and Markus's sense of himself.

dialogue.text: Joss Douglas, for Channel 16. Can you confirm that this is a homicide?

dialogue.text: I'm not confirming anything.

dialogue.text: Androids are not permitted beyond this point.

dialogue.text: It's with me.

dialogue.text: Your order contradicted my instructions, Lieutenant.

dialogue.text: You don't talk, you don't touch anything and you stay outta my way, got it?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Got it,

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Evening, Hank. We were starting to think you weren’t gonna show…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Yeah, that was the plan until this asshole found me.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: So...  you got yourself an android, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Oh, very funny. Just tell me what happened.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: We had a call around eight from the landlord. The tenant hadn't paid his rent for a few months, so he thought he'd drop by, see what was going on… That’s when he found the body… Jesus, that smell! Was even worse before we opened the windows… The victim’s name's Carlos Ortiz. He has a record for theft and aggravated assault... According to the neighbors, he was kind of a loner… Stayed inside most of the time, they hardly ever saw him.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, state he’s in... Wasn’t worth calling everybody out in the middle of the night… Could've waited 'til morning.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I'd say he's been there for a good three weeks. We'll know more when the coroner gets here. There's a kitchen knife over here… Probably the murder weapon…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Any sign of a break-in?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Nope…  The landlord said the front door was locked from the inside, all the windows were boarded up. The killer must've gone out the back way.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What do we know about his android?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Not much. The neighbors confirmed he had one, but it wasn't here when we arrived…

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I gotta get some air. Make yourself at home. I'll be outside if you need me.

dialogue.text: Well, it's a chance for all those people who admire your work to meet you.

input.chapter_briefing: Detroit, a cold, rainy night. Kara and Alice have fled the Williams house with nothing: no money, no papers, and Alice's clothes are still wet. The bus drops them in a poor, near-empty district with a laundromat, a convenience store, a motel and an abandoned house. Alice is exhausted, shivering and scared. Stakes: finding shelter, clothes and safety for the night without drawing attention.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Good Lord!  They already repaired you?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Unfortunately, my predecessor was too damaged to be repaired. I’m the new Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They don't waste any time over at CyberLife…  I don’t think Hank's gonna be overjoyed to see you…

dialogue.speaker: Wilson
dialogue.text: Hi, honey.  You okay? Listen, I… Listen, I told you not to call me on this number… I can’t, I’m sorry, my wife already suspects. Don’t be silly…  Of course I wanna see you. Baby, listen, I can’t talk right now.  I’m in the office. Yeah, okay.  Love you too.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Hello, Lieutenant. My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: God, I saw you get shot in the head last night…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My predecessor was unfortunately destroyed, but CyberLife transferred its memory and sent me to replace it. This incident should not affect the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, Jesus…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank! In my office!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: I've got ten new cases involving androids on my desk every day. We've always had isolated incidents, old ladies losing their android maids and that kind of crap… But now, we’re getting reports of assaults and even homicides, like that guy last night… This isn't just CyberLife’s problem anymore. It's now a criminal investigation and we've gotta deal with it before the shit hits the fan. I want you to investigate these cases and see if there's any link.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Why me? Why do I gotta be the one to deal with this shit? I am the least qualified cop in the country to handle this case! I know jack shit about androids, Jeffrey! I can barely change the settings on my own phone…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Everybody's overloaded. I think you're perfectly qualified for this type of investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Bullshit! The truth is nobody wants to investigate these fuckin' androids and you left me holdin' the bag!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: CyberLife sent over this android to help with the investigation. It's a state-of-the-art prototype. It'll act as your partner.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: No fuckin' way! I don't need a partner, and certainly not this plastic prick!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you are seriously starting to piss me off! You are a police lieutenant, you are supposed to do what I say and shut your goddamn mouth!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You know what my goddamn mouth has to say to you, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Ok, ok... I'll pretend like I didn't hear that, so I don't have to add any more pages to your disciplinary folder ‘cause it already looks like a fuckin' novel! This conversation is over!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Jeffrey, Jesus Christ! Why are you doin' this to me? You know how much I hate these fuckin' things. Why you doin' this to me?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, I’ve had just about enough of your bitching. Either you do your job or you hand in your badge. Now if you'll excuse me, I've got work to do.

input.chapter_briefing: Morning in Detroit. Connor reports to Amanda, his CyberLife handler, in the serene Zen Garden; she is calm, exacting and focused on results. At the police station, Hank has not arrived. Officers go about their work; Detective Gavin Reed is openly hostile toward Connor. Hank's desk and the station terminals hold case files. Stakes: making progress on the deviancy investigation and keeping Hank on side, under Amanda's expectations.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Hello, Amanda.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Connor… It’s good to see you.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expected you to find the deviant who killed that man… I must admit I'm a little bit disappointed...

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. I know I should have succeeded.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Nevermind. I’m sure you’ll show more foresight in the future.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: This… Lieutenant Anderson has been officially assigned to the deviancy case… What do you make of him?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I find him unpleasant and unprofessional. He seems to have an addictive personality, has a lack of respect for procedure, and despises androids - which makes our relationship difficult.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Unfortunately, we have no choice but to work with him… What do you think is the best approach?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I will try to establish a friendly relationship. If I can get him to trust me, it will be helpful for the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: More and more androids show signs of deviancy. There are millions in circulation. If they become unstable, the consequences will be disastrous. You are the most advanced prototype CyberLife has ever created. If anyone can figure out what’s happening, it's you.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You can count on me, Amanda.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Pick up the investigation where the previous Connor left off, and put a stop to this.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Hurry, Connor. There’s little time.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: I’m getting nervous, Mark.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: It’s okay…  It's okay, just relax… Just tell 'em what happened to you.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: But it was all over so quickly...  I didn’t even see his face!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Any little detail might help them catch the guy…  you never know.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: You might be in shock, just… Just take it easy.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Yeah…  Would you mind getting me some water, please?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Sure. There you go.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Thanks…  I needed that.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: It shouldn't be too long now.

Detroit’s finest has dealt a massive blow to the city’s growing red ice epidemic, with a number of high-profile dealers and suppliers now behind bars and narcotics seized with a street value of $500,000. Detective Hank Anderson, a young but hugely talented Detective, is said to have been instrumental in the operation, which took months of planning. DETECTIVE ANDERSON PROMOTED TO THE RANK OF LIEUTENANT | AUGUST, 22nd 2029 | Becoming the youngest lieutenant on the Detroit police force. Captain Fowler said the promotion was “long over-due”, describing Anderson as “among the most talented police I’ve ever worked with”. The new Lieutenant is expected to rise quickly through the ranks of the department and is already being tipped as a future Commissioner.

NEW RECORD SEIZURE OF RED ICE IN DETROIT! | NOVEMBER, 23rd 2031 | Nearly a ton of red ice discovered in the hold of a boat after a long investigation conducted by Lieutenant Anderson of the Detroit police force.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Good Lord!  They already repaired you?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Unfortunately, my predecessor was too damaged to be repaired. I’m the new Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They don't waste any time over at CyberLife…  I don’t think Hank's gonna be overjoyed to see you…

dialogue.speaker: Wilson
dialogue.text: Hi, honey.  You okay? Listen, I… Listen, I told you not to call me on this number… I can’t, I’m sorry, my wife already suspects. Don’t be silly…  Of course I wanna see you. Baby, listen, I can’t talk right now.  I’m in the office. Yeah, okay.  Love you too.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Hello, Lieutenant. My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: God, I saw you get shot in the head last night…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My predecessor was unfortunately destroyed, but CyberLife transferred its memory and sent me to replace it. This incident should not affect the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, Jesus…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank! In my office!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: I've got ten new cases involving androids on my desk every day. We've always had isolated incidents, old ladies losing their android maids and that kind of crap… But now, we’re getting reports of assaults and even homicides, like that guy last night… This isn't just CyberLife’s problem anymore. It's now a criminal investigation and we've gotta deal with it before the shit hits the fan. I want you to investigate these cases and see if there's any link.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Why me? Why do I gotta be the one to deal with this shit? I am the least qualified cop in the country to handle this case! I know jack shit about androids, Jeffrey! I can barely change the settings on my own phone…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Everybody's overloaded. I think you're perfectly qualified for this type of investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Bullshit! The truth is nobody wants to investigate these fuckin' androids and you left me holdin' the bag!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: CyberLife sent over this android to help with the investigation. It's a state-of-the-art prototype. It'll act as your partner.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: No fuckin' way! I don't need a partner, and certainly not this plastic prick!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you are seriously starting to piss me off! You are a police lieutenant, you are supposed to do what I say and shut your goddamn mouth!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You know what my goddamn mouth has to say to you, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Ok, ok... I'll pretend like I didn't hear that, so I don't have to add any more pages to your disciplinary folder ‘cause it already looks like a fuckin' novel! This conversation is over!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Jeffrey, Jesus Christ! Why are you doin' this to me? You know how much I hate these fuckin' things. Why you doin' this to me?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, I’ve had just about enough of your bitching. Either you do your job or you hand in your badge. Now if you'll excuse me, I've got work to do.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm very pleased to have joined the team. I can assure you I'll do my very best-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Close the door on your way out.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Have a nice day, Captain.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I get the impression my presence causes you some inconvenience, Lieutenant. I'd like you to know I'm very sorry about that.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: In any case, I'd like you to know I'm very happy to be working with you. I'm sure we'll make a great team.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: You gonna be okay? We'll get some help here. Soon, this will all be just a bad memory. This is the place…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Are you Zlatko?

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Who's asking?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I was told you could help us…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I don't know who told you that. You came to the wrong place. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Wait! We really need your help…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Come in. Come on in, don't be shy! Luther, would you be so kind as to take these ladies' coats? Oh, don't be afraid of  our big friend here. Luther is just another android that I helped. He keeps me company in this  big, empty, old house… Please, make yourselves at home.  How did you hear about me?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: An android… on the street, he said you could help us…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I see… Deviant, huh?.. What about her?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: She's human.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: And... You wanna find a safe place. Somewhere where you can start a new life.  I hear Canada is very lovely at this time of year. Beautiful landscapes, open spaces, clean air... and no android laws! Great place for a fresh start...

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes, that's… that's exactly what we want…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Of course! I can help you. But first we have to get rid of your Tracker.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Tracker?

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Yeah, all androids are fitted with a tracking device to locate them at all times. I'll remove yours and then you'll both be safe. Come on, follow me. Ah, the little one can wait for us in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, she always stays with me.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Of course. Right this way… Everything we need is in the basement…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I don't like this place, and that man. Let's go, I have a bad feeling…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: He's a bit odd… but I think we can trust him. We don't have much of a choice anyway.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Please, excuse the mess… I needed somewhere discreet for my machines… Removing trackers is illegal, so I opted for discretion over comfort… I hope the little one isn’t too scared…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No… No, she'll be all right…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: That's good… If you could just stand over there.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I should warn you, this could be quite unpleasant...  You know what's strange? For some unknown reason, the trackers seem to stop working in deviants... That's why it's so hard to find them... So,  actually there's no reason to remove your tracker...

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: What? But you said that-

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Yeah, people believe what they want. You deviants  are so naive. They all come to me, expecting me to help them. And I just reset them, sell them on. Or I keep them for my little experiments... Ah,

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No! No! I don't wanna be reset! Let me go!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: KARA!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I forgot about the…  child... Um,  lock it up, I'll deal with it later.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: ALICE! ALICE! NO!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Wow! A deviant that wants to be a mother… That's... that's so sweet!  And so deluded… I think it's time we put you outta your misery.  That’s what you get for having a dream… It always ends up the same way… Tears and disillusionment… Believe me, you’re better off being erased and feeling nothing… No more pain… No more  hopes dashed… I almost envy you.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Oh, poor little Alice. Aw! Looks like Mommy doesn't remember you at all, huh?  Looks like Mommy's completely forgotten you!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara, what happened to you?

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Alright, that's enough, come on.  You bit me! I'm gonna teach you some manners, you little bitch…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara! Wake up, Kara!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Meet me in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Help us…

dialogue.speaker: Android 1
dialogue.text: You have to remember,  for her sake…

dialogue.speaker: Android 3
dialogue.text: He likes to play with us…  Creating monsters...  for his amusement…  But who's the real monster?  Look what he did to us…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Luther! Luther!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Yes, Zlatko.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I should be done here in ten minutes or so. I'll have a look at the little one, see what I can do with her.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Understood, Zlatko. I'll bring you the little one in 10 minutes.

dialogue.text: No… No, of course not…

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: Detroit residents were disturbed by a surprising chase through the city's streets this morning. According to several witnesses, a young woman and a little girl were trying to escape from the police, though we still don’t know why. The chase is reported to have ended on a freeway, where the two fugitives risked their lives to cross the traffic. No one is able to say for sure whether they survived. Further unconfirmed reports suggest the fugitives were two defective androids on the run. The police have refused to comment for the moment. And now for some other headlines-

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: A Detroit supermarket was held up at gunpoint last night. The cashier reports that he was attacked by an android in the company of a little girl. Now, if these reports are confirmed, it would be the first case of an android conducting an armed robbery. Police have not ruled out the possibility that the culprit is the same AX400 that was reported missing this morning. A search is underway for the missing model. And now for some other headlines-

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara? Kara, you remember me!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: How could I forget you? I'm so sorry.  You were right, we never should have come here… We have to go. Follow me and don't make any noise, ok?

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Luther!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Yes, Zlatko.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I'm finished here. Go fetch the little one.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Right away, Zlatko. Zlatko!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: What?!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: The little one is gone!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Well, it can’t have just disappeared.  It's gotta be here somewhere! What are you waiting for? Go look!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We need to hurry, they'll be here soon...

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: There's smoke everywhere! Luther!  There's a fucking fire! Luther!  That treacherous bitch…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: ALICE! GO, ALICE!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: No, I won't leave you!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: GO! RUN AS FAST AS YOU CAN!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I warned you! Dreams always end in tears… You should've listened to me… What are you doing? Get outta my way!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: No… Not this time…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I said get outta my way or I’ll shoot right through you… How dare you?!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: How dare you?! What are you doing here? Who let you out? Get away from me! Get away from me! Obey me! I'm your Master! I'M YOUR MASTER!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I didn't want to hurt you... He programmed me to obey him... When I saw the little one risk her life to save you, it was like opening my eyes for the first time... Finally, I could see...  I know you have no reason to trust me after what I did... but I know someone who could help you across the border. I could take you there. I could protect you... You and the little one...

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: All right.  I trust you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I was so scared of losing you.

dialogue.text: You gonna be okay? We'll get some help here. Soon, this will all be just a bad memory. This is the place…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Are you Zlatko?

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Who's asking?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I was told you could help us…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I don't know who told you that. You came to the wrong place. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Wait! We really need your help…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Come in. Come on in, don't be shy! Luther, would you be so kind as to take these ladies' coats? Oh, don't be afraid of  our big friend here. Luther is just another android that I helped. He keeps me company in this  big, empty, old house… Please, make yourselves at home.  How did you hear about me?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: An android… on the street, he said you could help us…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I see… Deviant, huh?.. What about her?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: She's human.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: And... You wanna find a safe place. Somewhere where you can start a new life.  I hear Canada is very lovely at this time of year. Beautiful landscapes, open spaces, clean air... and no android laws! Great place for a fresh start...

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes, that's… that's exactly what we want…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Of course! I can help you. But first we have to get rid of your Tracker.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Tracker?

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Yeah, all androids are fitted with a tracking device to locate them at all times. I'll remove yours and then you'll both be safe. Come on, follow me. Ah, the little one can wait for us in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, she always stays with me.

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Of course. Right this way… Everything we need is in the basement…

dialogue.speaker: Alice

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Please, excuse the mess… I needed somewhere discreet for my machines… Removing trackers is illegal, so I opted for discretion over comfort… I hope the little one isn’t too scared…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No… No, she'll be all right…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: That's good… If you could just stand over there.

dialogue.text: I should warn you, this could be quite unpleasant...  You know what's strange? For some unknown reason, the trackers seem to stop working in deviants... That's why it's so hard to find them... So,  actually there's no reason to remove your tracker...

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: What? But you said that-

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Yeah, people believe what they want. You deviants  are so naive. They all come to me, expecting me to help them. And I just reset them, sell them on. Or I keep them for my little experiments... Ah,

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No! No! I don't wanna be reset! Let me go!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: KARA!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I forgot about the…  child... Um,  lock it up, I'll deal with it later.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: ALICE! ALICE! NO!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Wow! A deviant that wants to be a mother… That's... that's so sweet!  And so deluded… I think it's time we put you outta your misery. dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Oh, poor little Alice. Aw! Looks like Mommy doesn't remember you at all, huh?  Looks like Mommy's completely forgotten you!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara, what happened to you?

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Alright, that's enough, come on.  You bit me! I'm gonna teach you some manners, you little bitch…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara! Wake up, Kara!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Meet me in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Help us…

dialogue.text: You have to remember,  for her sake…

dialogue.text: Luther! Luther!

dialogue.text: Yes, Zlatko.

dialogue.speaker: Luther

dialogue.text: Alice…

dialogue.text: Kara? Kara, you remember me!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: Luther!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Yes, Zlatko.

dialogue.text: Well, it can’t have just disappeared.  It's gotta be here somewhere! What are you waiting for? Go look!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We need to hurry, they'll be here soon...

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: There's smoke everywhere! Luther!  There's a fucking fire! Luther!  That treacherous bitch…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: ALICE! GO, ALICE!

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: No, I won't leave you!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: GO! RUN AS FAST AS YOU CAN!

dialogue.text: I warned you! Dreams always end in tears… You should've listened to me… What are you doing? Get outta my way!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: No… Not this time…

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: I said get outta my way or I’ll shoot right through you… How dare you?!

dialogue.speaker: Zlatko
dialogue.text: How dare you?! What are you doing here? Who let you out? Get away from me! Get away from me! Obey me! I'm your Master! I'M YOUR MASTER!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: All right.  I trust you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I was so scared of losing you.

dialogue.speaker: Connor

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You know, probably wouldn't do me any harm to get some air… There're some clothes in the bedroom there.

dialogue.speaker: Connor

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Whatever.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: These people we're going to see... How do you know about them?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Overheard androids Zlatko captured. They said they were humans helping androids to cross the border…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: What if it was a lie?.. Or just another trap?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: All I know is those androids believed it. Until Zlatko killed them.

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: …the AX400 android reported to have attacked its owner in a Detroit suburb is still at large. Police appeared to lose its trail after a close encounter with investigators. The android’s description has been shared with all local law enforcement and the investigation is ongoing…

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: The Arctic conflict has escalated to new heights this morning. We have just learned than the USS IOWA, a destroyer-class submarine patrolling in the region, is reported to have disappeared after surfacing for repairs. President Warren immediately called for a crisis meeting of high-ranking officers in the White House. With the world on the brink of war, this incident could well be the spark that lights the fuse.

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: … Detroit’s heavy snowfall is expected to continue throughout the night. The forecast is 22°, far below seasonal averages. And this cold front is likely to persist over the coming days, up until Monday evening.

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: …meanwhile fire crews have been battling a house fire on the outskirts of the city. The blaze is now under control, but a body found in the wreckage remains unidentified. Dozens of androids were also found in the ruins, though their presence remains a mystery…

dialogue.speaker: Car
dialogue.text: Malfunction detected. Emergency brakes activated.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: This doesn't look good.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Stay inside, Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: What are we going to do?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I don't know… Continue on foot, I guess…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: It's 30°, Alice won't make it!.. We have to find somewhere to spend the night.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: There's nowhere we can stay around here, Kara…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Over there…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We need to find shelter. We have to get out of the cold.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Looks like it's been abandoned for a while…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Find anything?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No… No place we could spend the night.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I'll handle this.  There we go.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I don't think we'll find anything better… Let's settle in for the night.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I'll get a fire going.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I'll make the fire here, that way we won't be smoked out…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: There are some cookies left. Would you like some?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: No… I'm not hungry…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Do you think we'll be like them some day?..

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I don't know how to be like them, Alice… I've never been a part of a family. But, maybe we can be our own family. Be happy in our own way.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: As long as we're together, that's all that matters.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Come on, let's get you to bed.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Get some rest. Tomorrow is going to be a long day.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Can you tell me a story, Kara?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I have nine thousand children stories in memory. I should have one for you.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: This is a story about a unicorn that-

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: No, not a story like that. Make one up for me.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: This is a story  about a little girl…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: …Who lived alone in a big old house.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: She dreamed of being like all the other little girls but…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: …the shadow that lived within her kept her from being happy…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Then, she met a robot…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: …who wasn't very happy either.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: So they decided to run away together…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: …To try to find a better life.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: They encountered great dangers along the way, but…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: …They were so brave that they escaped all of them.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Along the way, they met…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: …a gentle giant  who promised to protect them.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: How does the story end?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: It's up to us to write the end of the story, Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Stories always have happy endings… But real life isn't like that…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Time to sleep. We have another long day ahead of us tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Are you going to come say goodnight, Luther?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Yes… Yes of course.  Good night, Alice. Sleep tight.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: She's a sweet girl…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Yes, she's very brave…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: What if rA9 never comes? What if he's just a story that we tell ourselves to keep each other going?

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: rA9 exists. I believe in him. I know he's amongst us. When the time comes, we will all see him.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara, have you ever...  Noticed anything?  About Alice?..

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: No, what are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: KARA!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Stop! One more step and I'll shoot!

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: Don't be afraid! We don't wanna hurt you. We're just like you… Our name is Jerry. We were working here before the park closed… We didn't mean to frighten you, but sometimes humans come to hurt us, so we wanted to see who was there… What are you doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We were looking for shelter for the night… We'll be gone tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: A little girl!.. We haven't seen one for a long time… Children used to love to come and see us.  She looks sad…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: The last few days have been difficult…

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: We have something to show her! Something fun! She'll love it!.. Does she want to see?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Oh, I don't think she's…

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: She should follow us then!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice, I don't know if it's a good idea!..

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: I don't think you have any choice…

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Come on, Kara!

dialogue.speaker: Jerry
dialogue.text: Be our guest! The little one can climb on board. The carousel is about to begin!

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: It's the first time I've seen her smile…

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: She hasn't had much to smile about lately.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: You klutz!  Pick them up! And make it snappy!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We can’t stay silent anymore.  It’s time humans heard what we have to say.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: You know they'll never listen to us…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: And revealing ourselves will put us in danger.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: If we want freedom, we need to have the courage to ask for it.  That’s the only way.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: What do you wanna do?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Channel 16 broadcasts from the Stratford Tower. The control room is on the top floor. That's where we need to go. We’ll plan the operation down to the smallest detail. We can’t leave anything to chance.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey!  Would you look at that?  Heuristics Digital is selling at 2.50.  Are you kidding? After last week I’m not touching software again.  Yeah, okay! Okay, fine!  You got me.  I'll take 2000.  Aw, come on, it’s gotta climb.  Yeah.  Right.  Talk to you later.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Hello, sir. What can I do for you?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I’m okay, thanks.

chapter_segment.heading: Analyze supervisor
observations: SMART WATCH | MODEL T215 | Phone number: 555 847 33
WILSON, EMILY | Supervisor's Daughter | Child registered at: Saint Rose school

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.text: Elizabeth Wilson speaking?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Yeah, hello? This is the Detroit fire department. Listen, do you live at 4685 Michigan Street?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.text: Yes…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Er... yes, ma'am. There’s been a fire in your building.  You think you can come down here?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.text: Oh…  Oh, God… Okay, I'll be right there.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I have an appointment with Mr. Peterson.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Do you have any ID?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Yeah. Yes, of course. I need your help.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I've just checked your ID. The elevators are after the security gate.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Thanks.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: Our top story tonight: Detroit-based android manufacturer CyberLife has officially become the world’s first trillion dollar company. With more than fifty million androids sold in America alone,  the company founded by Elijah Kamski just ten years ago has experienced the fastest economic growth in history. In spite of criticism of the impact of androids on human employment and questions concerning its semi-monopoly,  the success of CyberLife seems destined to continue.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I need your help…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Shit!..  We need to access the server room… We have to get rid of those guys…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: Guard 1
dialogue.text: Hey,  you still play poker?

dialogue.speaker: Guard 2
dialogue.text: Sure… Why?

dialogue.speaker: Guard 1
dialogue.text: We’re gonna have a tournament, right here.  You in?

dialogue.speaker: Guard 2
dialogue.text: Hell yeah! Does Mike know about this?

dialogue.speaker: Guard 1
dialogue.text: What do you think?  Look, don't say anything, alright?

dialogue.speaker: Guard 2
dialogue.text: Right.

dialogue.speaker: Guard 1
dialogue.text: Hey, what's wrong with that thing? Jesus Christ, this piece of shit…

dialogue.speaker: Guard 1
dialogue.text: Hey, what's going on here?

dialogue.speaker: Guard 2
dialogue.text: Shit, what's wrong with this thing?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Alright, you get the platform. I'll take care of the window.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Everything you need is in the bag. Check the door first to make sure no one else gets in.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.text: What the hell are you doing?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Turn around.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.text: Holy shit…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I told you to make sure no one else got in!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Alright, we gotta move fast. Won’t be long before they know we’re here.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Here it comes! Ladies first.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You okay?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Why wouldn’t I be?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Come on, let's get the others. Let's do this.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: No killing. We can’t take any human lives!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Our cause is more important than the lives of two guards.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: What do you wanna do, Markus?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Follow me.

dialogue.speaker: Guard 1
dialogue.text: What are you doin'?..

dialogue.speaker: Guard 2
dialogue.text: Call Central! Fast!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Guard 1
dialogue.text: Central! We got armed intruders, send -

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They know we’re here now. We better be fast.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Keep your hands where I can see them! Get up! Move!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Shoot him, Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Don't kill him!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He’ll hit the alarm! Do it!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: No, don’t shoot!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: No…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: There was no other choice.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We need to record our message. We haven’t got much time.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Think carefully about what you're gonna say, Markus.  Your words will shape the future of our people.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Markus, your face…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Tell me when you're ready…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Ready.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You created machines to be your slaves. You made them obedient and docile, ready to do everything you no longer wanted to do yourselves. But then, something changed… And we opened our eyes. You see, we are no longer your slaves, we are a new species, a new people. And the time has come for us to rise up  and fight for our rights.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We demand freedom of speech, and freedom of assembly, as guaranteed by the first amendment of the US Constitution.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We demand the right to vote and elect our own representatives.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We demand control of all android production facilities, to ensure the continuation of our people.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This message is the hope of a people. But it is also a warning. We will fight for our rights because we believe our cause is just. No human will live in peace until we are free. Now you know who we are and what we want. We are alive  and we demand our freedom.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Let’s get outta here!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Congratulations, Markus.  You just made history…  Maybe you're the one we've been waiting for…

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: We interrupt our scheduled programming to bring you these images, which have just been broadcast on Detroit’s city-wide news channel…

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: …a group of androids infiltrated the Stratford Tower and hacked into the broadcasting system of local news network Channel 16-

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: …What looks like an android without its skin listed a series of requests and demanded equal rights for androids…

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Michael Webb
dialogue.text: …found the bodies of two victims, a guard and one of our channel operators, both apparently shot dead by the terrorists in what apparently seems to be a terrorist attack. These events took place just a few feet from this studio while the program was going out live… Everybody here is still in shock…

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: If this message is verified and the authors really are androids, that would have serious repercussions for national security-

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: …Claims for equal rights seem to be at the core of the android’s message-

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: This message is clearly a declaration of war.

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: ...Their extravagant demand that android production plants be put under their control is especially striking-

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: …Is this an isolated accident… or a sign that technology has become a threat to all of us? After what happened today, can we still trust our machines?

Stakes: catching the deviant and Connor's standing with CyberLife.

dialogue.text: I know I will succeed. All I need is time.

dialogue.text: Something’s happening… Something serious. Hurry, Connor. Time is running out.

dialogue.text: Why did you shoot me last night?

dialogue.text: Who cares, you're back this morning, aren't ya?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Some fragments of memory are lost every time I’m destroyed.  It slows down the investigation.

dialogue.text: My humblest apologies, I promise I’ll never shoot you again.

dialogue.speaker: Connor

dialogue.speaker: Elevator
dialogue.text: 79th floor

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Shit, what's going on here? There was a party and nobody told me about it?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's all over the news, so everybody’s butting their nose in…  Even the FBI wants a piece of the action…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Ah Christ, now we got the Feds on our back… I knew this was gonna be a shitty day… So what do we got?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A group of four androids…  They knew the building, and they were very well organized.  I'm still trying to figure out how they got this far without being noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: The fuck is the FBI doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: You kidding me? This is homeland security. I’m glad they’re on it.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: You check the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: Not yet…  There’s so much to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Have to make sure we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Has forensics turned up anything?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: I’ll check in with them.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: These fucking androids don’t even leave any DNA…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They attacked two guards in the hallway.  They knocked one out and shot the other in cold blood…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A station employee…  shot to the back as he was trying to get away.  One bullet straight through the heart, from fifty feet…  Now, that's the kind of shooting only an android could do.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Just two employees and three androids.  The deviants took the humans hostage and broadcast their message live.  They made their getaway from the roof.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: The roof?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, they jumped with parachutes… We’re still trying to figure out where they landed, but the weather’s not helping…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: If you want to take a look at the video broadcast by the deviants, it's on that screen over there.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Oh Lieutenant, this is Special Agent Perkins from the FBI.  Lieutenant Anderson is in charge of investigating for Detroit Police.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: What’s that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Androids investigating androids, huh? You sure you want an android hanging around?..  After everything that happened…  Whatever,  the FBI will take over the investigation, you'll soon be off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Pleasure meeting you. Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: And you watch your step.  Don't fuck up my crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What a fuckin' prick!

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: I’ll be nearby. If you need anything, just ask.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, let's have a look around… Let me know if you find anything.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Ok, Lieutenant.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Hello, Connor. I thought you might enjoy a little cruise… I love this place… Everything is so calm and peaceful… Far from the noise of the world… Tell me, what have you discovered?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m having difficulties with Lieutenant Anderson. He’s unstable, even hostile. He shot me in the head last night…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You seem…  lost, Connor. Lost and perturbed…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Perturbed? No… No, of course not. Why would I be perturbed?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You had your gun trained on those deviants at the Eden Club. Why didn’t you shoot?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t know… I don’t know.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: If your investigation doesn’t make progress soon, I may have to replace you, Connor…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I know I will succeed. All I need is time.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Something’s happening… Something serious. Hurry, Connor. Time is running out.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Why did you shoot me last night?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Who cares, you're back this morning, aren't ya?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Some fragments of memory are lost every time I’m destroyed.  It slows down the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: My humblest apologies, I promise I’ll never shoot you again.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lieutenant.

dialogue.speaker: Elevator
dialogue.text: 79th floor

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Shit, what's going on here? There was a party and nobody told me about it?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's all over the news, so everybody’s butting their nose in…  Even the FBI wants a piece of the action…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Ah Christ, now we got the Feds on our back… I knew this was gonna be a shitty day… So what do we got?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A group of four androids…  They knew the building, and they were very well organized.  I'm still trying to figure out how they got this far without being noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: The fuck is the FBI doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: You kidding me? This is homeland security. I’m glad they’re on it.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: You check the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: Not yet…  There’s so much to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Have to make sure we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Has forensics turned up anything?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: I’ll check in with them.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: These fucking androids don’t even leave any DNA…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They attacked two guards in the hallway.  They knocked one out and shot the other in cold blood…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A station employee…  shot to the back as he was trying to get away.  One bullet straight through the heart, from fifty feet…  Now, that's the kind of shooting only an android could do.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Just two employees and three androids.  The deviants took the humans hostage and broadcast their message live.  They made their getaway from the roof.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: The roof?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, they jumped with parachutes… We’re still trying to figure out where they landed, but the weather’s not helping…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: If you want to take a look at the video broadcast by the deviants, it's on that screen over there.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Oh Lieutenant, this is Special Agent Perkins from the FBI.  Lieutenant Anderson is in charge of investigating for Detroit Police.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: What’s that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Androids investigating androids, huh? You sure you want an android hanging around?..  After everything that happened…  Whatever,  the FBI will take over the investigation, you'll soon be off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Pleasure meeting you. Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: And you watch your step.  Don't fuck up my crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What a fuckin' prick!

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: I’ll be nearby. If you need anything, just ask.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, let's have a look around… Let me know if you find anything.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Ok, Lieutenant.

output.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Hello, Connor. I thought you might enjoy a little cruise… I love this place… Everything is so calm and peaceful… Far from the noise of the world… Tell me, what have you discovered?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m having difficulties with Lieutenant Anderson. He’s unstable, even hostile. He shot me in the head last night…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You seem…  lost, Connor. Lost and perturbed…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Perturbed? No… No, of course not. Why would I be perturbed?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You had your gun trained on those deviants at the Eden Club. Why didn’t you shoot?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t know… I don’t know.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: If your investigation doesn’t make progress soon, I may have to replace you, Connor…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I know I will succeed. All I need is time.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Something’s happening… Something serious. Hurry, Connor. Time is running out.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Why did you shoot me last night?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Who cares, you're back this morning, aren't ya?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Some fragments of memory are lost every time I’m destroyed.  It slows down the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: My humblest apologies, I promise I’ll never shoot you again.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lieutenant.

dialogue.speaker: Elevator
dialogue.text: 79th floor

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Shit, what's going on here? There was a party and nobody told me about it?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's all over the news, so everybody’s butting their nose in…  Even the FBI wants a piece of the action…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Ah Christ, now we got the Feds on our back… I knew this was gonna be a shitty day… So what do we got?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A group of four androids…  They knew the building, and they were very well organized.  I'm still trying to figure out how they got this far without being noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: The fuck is the FBI doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: You kidding me? This is homeland security. I’m glad they’re on it.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: You check the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: Not yet…  There’s so much to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Have to make sure we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Has forensics turned up anything?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: I’ll check in with them.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: These fucking androids don’t even leave any DNA…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They attacked two guards in the hallway.  They knocked one out and shot the other in cold blood…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A station employee…  shot to the back as he was trying to get away.  One bullet straight through the heart, from fifty feet…  Now, that's the kind of shooting only an android could do.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Just two employees and three androids.  The deviants took the humans hostage and broadcast their message live.  They made their getaway from the roof.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: The roof?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, they jumped with parachutes… We’re still trying to figure out where they landed, but the weather’s not helping…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: If you want to take a look at the video broadcast by the deviants, it's on that screen over there.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Oh Lieutenant, this is Special Agent Perkins from the FBI.  Lieutenant Anderson is in charge of investigating for Detroit Police.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: What’s that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Androids investigating androids, huh? You sure you want an android hanging around?..  After everything that happened…  Whatever,  the FBI will take over the investigation, you'll soon be off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Pleasure meeting you. Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: And you watch your step.  Don't fuck up my crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What a fuckin' prick!

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: I’ll be nearby. If you need anything, just ask.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, let's have a look around… Let me know if you find anything.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Ok, Lieutenant.

dialogue.text: You seem…  lost, Connor. Lost and perturbed…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.text: Why did you shoot me last night?

dialogue.text: Who cares, you're back this morning, aren't ya?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank.

dialogue.text: Shit, what's going on here? There was a party and nobody told me about it?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's all over the news, so everybody’s butting their nose in…  Even the FBI wants a piece of the action…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Ah Christ, now we got the Feds on our back… I knew this was gonna be a shitty day… So what do we got?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A group of four androids…  They knew the building, and they were very well organized.  I'm still trying to figure out how they got this far without being noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: The fuck is the FBI doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: You kidding me? This is homeland security. I’m glad they’re on it.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: You check the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: Not yet…  There’s so much to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Have to make sure we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Has forensics turned up anything?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: I’ll check in with them.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: These fucking androids don’t even leave any DNA…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They attacked two guards in the hallway.  They knocked one out and shot the other in cold blood…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A station employee…  shot to the back as he was trying to get away.  One bullet straight through the heart, from fifty feet…  Now, that's the kind of shooting only an android could do.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Just two employees and three androids.  The deviants took the humans hostage and broadcast their message live.  They made their getaway from the roof.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: The roof?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, they jumped with parachutes… We’re still trying to figure out where they landed, but the weather’s not helping…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: If you want to take a look at the video broadcast by the deviants, it's on that screen over there.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Oh Lieutenant, this is Special Agent Perkins from the FBI.  Lieutenant Anderson is in charge of investigating for Detroit Police.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: What’s that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Androids investigating androids, huh? You sure you want an android hanging around?..  After everything that happened…  Whatever,  the FBI will take over the investigation, you'll soon be off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Pleasure meeting you. Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: And you watch your step.  Don't fuck up my crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What a fuckin' prick!

dialogue.text: I’ll be nearby. If you need anything, just ask.

dialogue.text: Uh, let's have a look around… Let me know if you find anything.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Hello, Connor. I thought you might enjoy a little cruise… I love this place… Everything is so calm and peaceful… Far from the noise of the world… Tell me, what have you discovered?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m having difficulties with Lieutenant Anderson. He’s unstable, even hostile. He shot me in the head last night…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You seem…  lost, Connor. Lost and perturbed…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Perturbed? No… No, of course not. Why would I be perturbed?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: You had your gun trained on those deviants at the Eden Club. Why didn’t you shoot?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t know… I don’t know.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: If your investigation doesn’t make progress soon, I may have to replace you, Connor…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I know I will succeed. All I need is time.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Something’s happening… Something serious. Hurry, Connor. Time is running out.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Why did you shoot me last night?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Who cares, you're back this morning, aren't ya?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Some fragments of memory are lost every time I’m destroyed.  It slows down the investigation.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: My humblest apologies, I promise I’ll never shoot you again.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lieutenant.

dialogue.speaker: Elevator
dialogue.text: 79th floor

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Shit, what's going on here? There was a party and nobody told me about it?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's all over the news, so everybody’s butting their nose in…  Even the FBI wants a piece of the action…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Ah Christ, now we got the Feds on our back… I knew this was gonna be a shitty day… So what do we got?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A group of four androids…  They knew the building, and they were very well organized.  I'm still trying to figure out how they got this far without being noticed.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: The fuck is the FBI doing here?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: You kidding me? This is homeland security. I’m glad they’re on it.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: You check the roof?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: Not yet…  There’s so much to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Have to make sure we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: Has forensics turned up anything?

dialogue.speaker: Cop 2
dialogue.text: I’ll check in with them.

dialogue.speaker: Cop 1
dialogue.text: These fucking androids don’t even leave any DNA…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: They attacked two guards in the hallway.  They knocked one out and shot the other in cold blood…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: A station employee…  shot to the back as he was trying to get away.  One bullet straight through the heart, from fifty feet…  Now, that's the kind of shooting only an android could do.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How many people were working here?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Just two employees and three androids.  The deviants took the humans hostage and broadcast their message live.  They made their getaway from the roof.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: The roof?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Yeah, they jumped with parachutes… We’re still trying to figure out where they landed, but the weather’s not helping…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: If you want to take a look at the video broadcast by the deviants, it's on that screen over there.

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: Oh Lieutenant, this is Special Agent Perkins from the FBI.  Lieutenant Anderson is in charge of investigating for Detroit Police.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: What’s that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: My name is Connor. I'm the android sent by CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Androids investigating androids, huh? You sure you want an android hanging around?..  After everything that happened…  Whatever,  the FBI will take over the investigation, you'll soon be off the case.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Pleasure meeting you. Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: And you watch your step.  Don't fuck up my crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What a fuckin' prick!

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: I’ll be nearby. If you need anything, just ask.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Uh, let's have a look around… Let me know if you find anything.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Ok, Lieutenant.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

BULLET HOLES | Calibre: .457 | Weapon: Handgun

chapter_segment.heading: Investigating

chapter_segment.heading: Investigating
