ROBERT, CHRIS | Estimated time of death: 13:53:36 | Cause of death: Fatal gunshot wound

dialogue.speaker: Cop
dialogue.text: Connor?..  You remember me? I was on that terrace… That android that took the little girl hostage? I was shot, you saved me…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I remember you.

dialogue.speaker: Cop
dialogue.text: I could have died on that terrace… But you saved my life… I never thought I'd say this  to an android, but… Thank you…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: They didn't break in?

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: No, no sign of forced entry.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: There are cameras in the hallway. The staff would have seen what was happening… Why did they let them in?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Maybe they didn't check the cameras…

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.text: We stored the station androids in the kitchen.  There's no evidence that they were involved but we didn’t know what else to do with them.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Think that's rA9?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Deviants say rA9 will set them free. This android seems to have that objective.

chapter_segment.heading: Look at the speech
observations: OPTICAL UNIT | #8087q - BLUE IRIS | SPARE PART
PUPIL REFLECTION | Recorded at 13:59:54 | Deviant had accomplices
RK-SERIES PROTOTYPE RK200 | Registered as 'Markus' | Gift from Elijah Kamski to Carl Manfred

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: D'you see something?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I identified its model and serial number…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Anything else I should know?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: No. Nothing.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: What is your function?

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I am a broadcast operator.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Were you present when the deviants broke in?

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I do not remember.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: One of you saw the attack on the surveillance cameras and said nothing. Which means there is a deviant in this room… and I’m going to find out which it is.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You’re going to be switched off. We're gonna search your memory and tear you apart piece by piece for analysis. You’re going to be destroyed! Do you hear me? Destroyed!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: No memory.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Hank!.. Hank, I need help!..

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It’s a deviant! STOP IT!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Connor! Connor, are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I tried to stop it but… I was too late.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: They made their way up through the whole building, past all the guards  and jumped off the roof with parachutes… Pretty fucking impressive I'd say.

chapter_segment.heading: On the roof
observations: DOOR | Wireless security lock | Recently hacked
SHOE PRINTS | Stratford maintenance footwear - standard issue | Recent - Partially covered by snow
WEAPONS | .457 Handgun | Stratford Tower Security issue

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: How'd they manage to smuggle in a big bag like that?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: They didn't… Someone brought it in for them.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You have to stop them! If they destroy it, we won't learn anything!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We can't save it, it's too late! We'll just get ourselves killed!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Connor! Connor you all right? Connor!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Okay…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Are you hurt?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm ok…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Jesus! You scared the shit outta me… For fuck sake, I told you not to move! Why do you never do what I say?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I was connected to its memory… when it fired… I felt it die… Like I was dying. I was scared… I saw something, in its memory… a word… painted on a piece of rusty metal … "Jericho"

input.chapter_briefing: A farmhouse outside Detroit, day, under a gray sky. Rose, a calm, motherly woman, hides fugitive androids and helps them reach Canada; her son Adam is wary of the newcomers. Kara, Alice and Luther are tired from running. Police are searching houses in the area. Stakes: staying hidden, Alice's trust, and the chance to cross the border.

dialogue.speaker: Adam

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: THAT IS ENOUGH ADAM! THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.text: Don’t mind him… Sometimes he just boils over… It’s been hard since his dad passed away… But he's a fine boy!.. I'll go see about getting you across the border tonight, okay?.. You stay here, I won't be long.

dialogue.speaker: Kara

dialogue.speaker: Policeman

dialogue.text: Our broadcast is all over the news… We got what we wanted. Now humans know…

dialogue.text: They kill our people every day. Do you think they agonize about it?

dialogue.text: That's no reason for us to become murderers.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: If killing is the price of freedom, I’ll pay it gladly!

dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This is a night our people will remember.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I’ve been waiting a long time for this…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: MARKUS! THIS WAY! QUICK!

dialogue.text: It’s okay… They’re gone…

dialogue.text: There's probably even more police in the area… We should be careful.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: The store's over here!

dialogue.speaker: Simon

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Our broadcast is all over the news… We got what we wanted. Now humans know…

dialogue.text: They took Markus’ message as a threat…

dialogue.text: Killing humans wasn't part of the plan.

dialogue.text: They kill our people every day. Do you think they agonize about it?

dialogue.text: You're too fond of humans, Josh. Maybe their lives matter to you more than ours?

dialogue.text: If you think murdering humans is going to make us free, then you’re as bad they are!

dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!

dialogue.text: And now… What are we gonna do?

dialogue.text: There are five CyberLife stores across Detroit. All selling us like merchandise. We’re going to attack those stores and set our people free.

dialogue.text: Attack stores? We’ve never done that before… They’re probably protected, they have security systems...

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: …not to mention police…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We break into five teams, one for each store. We hack their security systems and we strike... simultaneously at 2AM. No violence. We free our people, get them out of there before the police come.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This is a night our people will remember.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I’ve been waiting a long time for this…

dialogue.text: MARKUS! THIS WAY! QUICK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It’s okay… They’re gone…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's probably even more police in the area… We should be careful.

dialogue.text: The store's over here!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m sorry, but I don’t see where you're getting at.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Chloe? I’m sure you’re familiar with the Turing test. Mere formality, simple question of algorithms and computing capacity. What interests me  is whether machines are capable of empathy. I call it "the Kamski test", it's very simple, you'll see… Magnificent, isn't it? One of the first intelligent models developed by CyberLife. Young  and beautiful forever. A flower that will never wither… …But what is it really? Piece of plastic imitating a human? Or a living being... With a soul...  It's up to you to answer that fascinating question, Connor.  Destroy this machine and I'll tell you all I know. Or spare it, if you feel it's alive, but you'll leave here without having learnt anything from me.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Okay, I think we’re done here. Come on, Connor. Let's go. Sorry to get you outta your pool.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What's more important to you, Connor? Your investigation, or the life of this android? Decide who you are. An obedient machine… Or a living being  endowed  with free will…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: That's enough! Connor, we’re leaving.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Is everything ok, lieutenant?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Chris was on patrol last night. He was attacked by a bunch of deviants… He said he was saved by Markus himself...

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Is Chris ok?

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I heard Officer Chris was attacked by deviants last night.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Yeah, he was in the wrong place at the wrong time… but he got lucky… He said that this Markus intervened to save him… He’s still in shock but... at least he’s alive…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Hi… Uh... I'm, er, Lieutenant Hank Anderson, Detroit Police Department. I'm here to see Mr. Elijah Kamski.

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Please, come in.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Okay.

chapter_segment.heading: Analysing photo of Amanda and Kamski

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Amanda…

dialogue.speaker: Chloe
dialogue.text: Elijah will see you now.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Mister Kamski?

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Just a moment, please.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I'm Lieutenant Anderson. This is Connor.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What can I do for you, Lieutenant?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Sir, we’re investigating deviants. I know you left CyberLife years ago but,  I was hoping you'd be able to tell us something we don’t know…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Deviants… Fascinating, aren't they? Perfect beings with infinite intelligence, and now they have free will… Machines are so superior to us, confrontation was inevitable… Humanity’s greatest achievement threatens to be its downfall. Isn’t it ironic?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Deviancy seems to spread like some kind of virus. We thought you might know something about that.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: All ideas are viruses that spread like epidemics...  Is the desire to be free a contagious disease?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Listen, I didn’t come here to talk philosophy. The machines you created may be planning a revolution. Either you can tell us something that'll be helpful, or we will be on our way.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What about you, Connor? Whose side are you on?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I have no side. I was designed to stop deviants and that’s what I intend to do.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Well, that's what you're programmed to say… but you… what do you really want?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I’m sorry, but I don’t see where you're getting at.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Chloe? I’m sure you’re familiar with the Turing test. Mere formality, simple question of algorithms and computing capacity. What interests me  is whether machines are capable of empathy. I call it "the Kamski test", it's very simple, you'll see… Magnificent, isn't it? One of the first intelligent models developed by CyberLife. Young  and beautiful forever. A flower that will never wither… …But what is it really? Piece of plastic imitating a human? Or a living being... With a soul...  It's up to you to answer that fascinating question, Connor.  Destroy this machine and I'll tell you all I know. Or spare it, if you feel it's alive, but you'll leave here without having learnt anything from me.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Okay, I think we’re done here. Come on, Connor. Let's go. Sorry to get you outta your pool.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: What's more important to you, Connor? Your investigation, or the life of this android? Decide who you are. An obedient machine… Or a living being  endowed  with free will…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: That's enough! Connor, we’re leaving.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Pull the trigger

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Connor, don’t…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: and I'll tell you what you wanna know.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck…

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Test negative. You chose your investigation over the life of another android. You feel no empathy.  I'm a man of my word. Ask one question... I'll tell you all I know.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I want to know how deviancy spreads.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: Androids share identification data when they meet another android. An error in this program would quickly spread like a virus, and become an epidemic. The virus would remains dormant, until an emotional shock occurs… Fear, anger, frustration. And the android becomes deviant.  Probably all started with one model, copy error… A zero instead of a one… Unless of course... Some kind of spontaneous mutation.  That’s all I know… An interesting question, Connor. But I doubt my answer be very helpful to you.

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: A war is coming... you’ll have to choose your side… Will you betray your own people  or stand against your creators? I wouldn't like to be in your shoes, Connor… What could be worse  than having to choose between two evils?

dialogue.speaker: Kamski
dialogue.text: By the way… I always leave an emergency exit in my programs… You never know…

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You shot that girl, for fuck’s sake…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It wasn't a girl, Lieutenant. It was a machine that looked like a girl.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You put your gun against her head and you blew her fucking brains out!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I did what I had to do to advance the investigation and I'd do it again if I had to!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You're a lowlife! You don't feel a thing, do you? A machine! That's what you are! You're just a fucking machine…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Of course I'm a machine, Lieutenant. What did you think I was?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought you… I thou-… Fuck.

dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler

dialogue.speaker: Hank

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought Kamski knew something… I was wrong…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Maybe he did…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where does CyberLife stand in all this? What do they really want?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: All CyberLife wants is to resolve the situation and keep selling androids.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t know what you’re talking about. I don’t feel anything, you know that. Are you suggesting that I’ve been compromised?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: No… No, of course not.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought Kamski knew something… I was wrong…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Maybe he did…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where does CyberLife stand in all this? What do they really want?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: All CyberLife wants is to resolve the situation and keep selling androids.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t know what you’re talking about. I don’t feel anything, you know that. Are you suggesting that I’ve been compromised?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: No… No, of course not.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought Kamski knew something… I was wrong…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Maybe he did…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where does CyberLife stand in all this? What do they really want?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: All CyberLife wants is to resolve the situation and keep selling androids.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t know what you’re talking about. I don’t feel anything, you know that. Are you suggesting that I’ve been compromised?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: No… No, of course not.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank
chapter_segment.description: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

chapter_segment.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank
chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: We can't just give up like that. I know we could have solved this case!..

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: So you're going back to CyberLife?

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I have no choice… I'll be deactivated and analyzed to find out why I failed…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What if we’re on the wrong side, Connor?  What if we’re fighting against people who just wanna be free?..

chapter_segment.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank
chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: When the deviants rise up, there will be chaos. We could have stopped it!.. But now it’s too late…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: When I was hanging off the roof, back at the urban farm, you let that deviant go in order to help me. You put my life above the mission.  You showed empathy, Connor. And empathy is a human emotion.

chapter_segment.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank
chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I don’t know why I did it…

chapter_segment.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank
chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm not programmed to say things like this, but... I really appreciated working with you. With a little more time, who knows... We might've even become friends…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Well, well, here comes Perkins, that motherfucker… Sure don't waste any time at the FBI…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: We can’t give up… I know the answer is in the evidence we collected. If Perkins takes it, it’s all over.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: There's no choice! You heard Fowler, we're off the case.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You've got to help me, Lieutenant. I need more time so I can find a lead in the evidence we collected. I know the solution is in there!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Listen, Connor…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: If I don't solve this case, CyberLife will destroy me. Five minutes. It's all I ask.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Key to the basement is on my desk... Get a move on! I can’t distract them forever.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Perkins! You fucking cocksucker!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Cop
dialogue.text: Stop it, Lieutenant!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck off! Leave me alone! Give me another shot at that little prick!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: He’s totally lost it.  Hey!  That's gonna cost you your badge, you lunatic!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: You know where you can stick my fucking badge!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Cop
dialogue.text: Come on, that's enough Lieutenant.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: I'm gonna bury that bastard!  Shit, I think he broke my fucking nose…

dialogue.speaker: Gavin
dialogue.text: Hey, Connor! I'm talking to you, asshole! Where you going?  We don’t need any plastic pricks around here! Or didn’t anybody tell you?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Gavin
dialogue.text: Hey, asshole, I’m talkin' to you!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Hank’s password…  What would a hard-boiled eccentric police lieutenant choose?..

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Ridiculous!..  No one would have a password like that…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where is Jericho?  The answer's here, somewhere.  Not much time...  Gotta think fast.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Rupert's diary…  But it’s useless,  it's encrypted.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Rupert.  The android with the birds…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Can you hear me? Your diary, Rupert.  You encrypted it. I need to know what you wrote.

chapter_segment.heading: Read the diary
observations: Diary | rA9 is the first. rA9 is our savior. rA9 is the one who'll free us. | The birds are my friends. The birds like being with me. They protect me. They reassure me. I look at them and I feel peaceful. | The android I met today spoke about Jericho. He says our people are free there. He told me to go to FERNDALE subway station. And to find the old docks. An old freighter called Jericho. I'm too fond of the birds to go to Jericho. But if I have to run, that's where I'll go.

chapter_segment.heading: Find Jericho by using The Tracis
chapter_segment.description: Find Jericho by using The Tracis

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: The two Tracis from Eden Club…  Were they headed to Jericho? Did they know how to get there?..

dialogue.speaker: Traci
dialogue.text: Traci...  Where's Traci?..

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Traci's not far away.  I can take you to her…  But first, you have to tell me how to find Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: Traci
dialogue.text: I remember you…  We could have escaped…  Been free…  But you killed us…  Disconnect me.  I'd rather be dead than live without her…

chapter_segment.heading: Go back with the Traci's head
chapter_segment.description: Go back with the Traci's head

chapter_segment.heading: Go back with the Traci's head

dialogue.speaker: Traci
dialogue.text: My love…  I thought you were dead…  We’ll get out of here…  We'll be free,  I promise…

chapter_segment.heading: Go back with the Traci's head

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Tell me where Jericho is…

chapter_segment.heading: Go back with the Traci's head

dialogue.speaker: Traci
dialogue.text: Give me your hand… Traci?  What's happening?!  Traci?!  TRAC-!

chapter_segment.description: Find Jericho by using the android from Public Enemy

dialogue.text: One of the deviants that hacked the TV station with Markus…  It must have known where the deviants are hiding.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: It's dark…  Where-  Where am I?..

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm a deviant…  like you…  I need your help.  I want to go to Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I don't... recognize your voice…  You're not one of us!  I'll never tell you where Jericho is!  Now leave me alone!..

dialogue.text: Who's there?..  Who are you?

dialogue.text: If the deviants start a war, they'll all be destroyed.  I can stop that, but you have to tell me where Jericho is.

dialogue.text: One of the deviants that hacked the TV station with Markus…  It must have known where the deviants are hiding.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's dark…  Where…  Where am I?..

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I reactivated you so you could help me.  I must find Jericho.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I don't recognize your voice, you're not one of us… I'll never tell you where Jericho is…  Now leave me alone!..

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Who's there?  Who are you?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.text: If the deviants start a war, they'll all be destroyed.  I can stop that, but you have to tell me where Jericho is.

chapter_segment.description: Find Jericho by using the statuette

chapter_segment.heading: Find Jericho by using the statuette

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: "The truth is inside"…  What was it trying to tell me?..

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Jericho is somewhere in the Ferndale neighborhood… Now I can scan their memories and narrow the search…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Jericho…  If I could just figure out where this memory was recorded…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Bingo.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: The deviant who took a child hostage…

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: You lied to me, Connor!  I trusted you, and you lied to me!..

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You were going to kill that child.  You gave me no choice.  I need to find Jericho,  do you know where it is?

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.text: You're wasting your time…  I don't know anything about Jericho.  But I hope that one day…  You pay for what you did to me…

dialogue.text: The android that murdered its owner…

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They've been conducting raids all over the city… Everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday… It's gonna be all right. We're almost there.

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: With all androids being turned over to the authorities, the country is grinding to a halt.  Hospitals and schools are closing. Water cuts, blackouts, and network failures are expected.  Maybe most worrying of all, our armed forces have lost two thirds of their effective personnel,  which consisted of specialized android models. The situation is extremely alarming.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: How about some music instead?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: A little further on that way, there's a large freighter called Jericho. When you get there, find Markus. He will help you. The last bus for the border leaves at midnight. You absolutely have to be on it. You'll be safer on the other side.  It's not much, but it's a start. My brother lives in Ontario, I've given you his address… He'll be able to hide you until things calm down.  You're a very brave little girl, Alice. You deserve to be happy.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you for everything, Rose.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Let me know when you make it over there, all right? And be careful.

dialogue.text: Take care of them.

dialogue.text: Come on, girls. We better not hang around. We have a bus to catch.

dialogue.text: We've got to find a warm place for Alice.

dialogue.text: How do you feel?

dialogue.text: Are you Markus?

dialogue.text: I'm with a little girl and another android… There's a bus leaving for the border in less than two hours, and we need passports…

dialogue.text: No, Detroit's under curfew. There're soldiers everywhere and they're rounding up all the androids and sending them to camps… Maybe you should  stay here a while.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right… We might be safer here until things calm down.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You said you’re with a little girl, right? You know that humans hate us… Why are you protecting her?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: They've been conducting raids all over the city… Everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday… It's gonna be all right. We're almost there.

dialogue.speaker: KNC - Rosanna Cartland
dialogue.text: With all androids being turned over to the authorities, the country is grinding to a halt.  Hospitals and schools are closing. Water cuts, blackouts, and network failures are expected.  Maybe most worrying of all, our armed forces have lost two thirds of their effective personnel,  which consisted of specialized android models. The situation is extremely alarming.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: How about some music instead?

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: A little further on that way, there's a large freighter called Jericho. When you get there, find Markus. He will help you. The last bus for the border leaves at midnight. You absolutely have to be on it. You'll be safer on the other side.  It's not much, but it's a start. My brother lives in Ontario, I've given you his address… He'll be able to hide you until things calm down.  You're a very brave little girl, Alice. You deserve to be happy.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you for everything, Rose.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Let me know when you make it over there, all right? And be careful.

dialogue.speaker: Rose
dialogue.text: Take care of them.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Come on, girls. We better not hang around. We have a bus to catch.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We've got to find a warm place for Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: How do you feel?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I'm hot and cold at the same time…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Stay with her. I'll try to find this Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: The last bus is in two hours. And the terminal's on the other side of town, we haven't got much time.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll leave as soon as we have passports…

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: Kara… There's something I have to tell you… It's about Alice…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: We'll have lots of time to talk on the bus… I'll be back. Stay with Alice.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Are you Markus?

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: I'm with a little girl and another android… There's a bus leaving for the border in less than two hours, and we need passports…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No, Detroit's under curfew. There're soldiers everywhere and they're rounding up all the androids and sending them to camps… Maybe you should  stay here a while.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right… We might be safer here until things calm down.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: One of our people used to work in the State Department. He has electronic passports he can easily modify. I’ll have him get them to you.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You said you’re with a little girl, right? You know that humans hate us… Why are you protecting her?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: It's a long story.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Alice?..

dialogue.speaker: Todd
dialogue.text: COME BACK HERE!  YOU'RE MINE!

dialogue.speaker: Luther
dialogue.text: You knew from the beginning. You just didn't want to see it. She wanted a mom, and you wanted someone to care for. You needed each other.  What difference does it make? Do you love her any less now that you know she's one of us?  Alice loves you Kara. She loves you more than anything in the world. She became the little girl you wanted! And you became the mother she needed. Forgetting who you are, to become what someone needs you to be... Maybe that's what it means to be alive.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Kara? Is there something wrong?..

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our wounded are shutting down and there's nothing we can do!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren is saying we’re a threat to national security and we need to be exterminated.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Humans are conducting raids in all the big cities and they're taking androids to camps to destroy them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's a disaster. They're slaughtering our people!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: It's all our fault... None of this would have happened if we'd just stayed quiet!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: What are we supposed to do? Live like cowards just to survive? We just wanna be free. That's a crime?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: It was a peaceful march, and you chose to attack. Now hundreds of humans and androids are dead! You reap what you sow!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You saw what they did to us back there! It doesn’t matter what we do. We either fight for our freedom, or we die in silence.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t forget who our enemies are. We can’t fight amongst ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He’s right. All that matters now is what we do next.  Markus?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to face them. There's no other choice.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: This is insanity.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Get all the guns that you can find. We're going to free Detroit.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I'm on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake, Markus. You won’t buy our freedom with blood!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans can't be reasoned with, they’re violent, hateful. They're stupid! What did they expect us to do? Shut up and obey?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They can't stop what we've started. Since you've been here, you've given us hope… You’ve given me hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: A dirty bomb…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can't lose this war, Markus. If humans overcome us, our people will disappear forever. This may be our only chance to survive if things go wrong…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t become like them, North. We can gain our freedom by other means.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I hope you're right…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Whatever happens tomorrow, I just want you to know that I- I'm glad I met you…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I'll go join the others.  Look after yourself… I don't wanna lose you.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our people are shutting down one after another and there's nothing we can do for them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren says we’re a threat to national security, we need to be exterminated… Markus would know what to do…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He’s the one that got us into this mess!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: He gave his life for our cause.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He put us all into danger by provoking humans! How much longer before they find Jericho now?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: At least he fought for us!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!  Markus is gone. It's up to us now to decide the future of our people.  We have to fight them.  There's no other way.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you choose a confrontation with humans, we're all going to die.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Gather up all the guns you can find, we leave at dawn.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I’m on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake North. You will not buy our freedom with blood.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're coming from all sides! Our people are trapped in the hold, they're gonna be slaughtered!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Where is Josh?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I don't know, we got separated.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Go and help the others. I'll join you later.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I won't be long.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: This is the end of Jericho…  Save our people, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Foxtrot team, hostiles sighted. Requesting orders.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader! Don’t let it get out! If they give you any trouble at all,  shoot them.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Affirmative, wilco.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Fuckin' android!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Go! ….

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Give me a sitrep!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on, let's get outta here!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: No!..  Please don't kill us!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: On your knees, now!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Don't hurt us!  We haven't done anything wrong…  Please…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Shut up! Put your hands on your head!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Markus…  You saved us…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Go now! Hurry!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Gamma squad out.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Tango Stop!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Look out!

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: Here they come!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: We surrender! We surrender, don't shoot!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Josh…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Quick, this way!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Find North! I’ll join you later!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Over there!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Are you all right?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're everywhere, they're killing anyone they can find…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We gotta get out of here. There's nothing we can do.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, I'm sorry-

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's no time, come on.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's too late, Markus! There's nothing we can do for her, we've gotta run!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Come on, Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Come on, Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: We found several hundred androids in the hull, Sir.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Take 'em away.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Yes, Sir.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Then clear the ship and order the men to withdraw.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: This isn’t over…

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Who are you? How did you get in?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I need to see Carl.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Carl isn't seeing anyone. You need to leave.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Please.  I need to see him.

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: He's very weak…  I'm not sure he'll be able to talk to you…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Carl…  No…

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Hey...

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: I was hoping you'd come…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I’ve missed you so much, Carl…  You don’t know how much I’ve missed you…

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: What's wrong, Markus?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I’m completely lost, Carl…  Completely lost… Whole world's falling apart around me…  I tried to do the right thing…  I looked for answers…  Instead, I just find more doubts and more uncertainty…

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: World is ruled by fear, Markus…  Fear of others…  Fear of the future…  It’s like me… too old…  It’s time for it to end.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans hate us…  They want to destroy us 'cause we refuse to be their slaves anymore…  I'm not gonna stand around and wait for them to slaughter my people!

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: You used to be so calm and thoughtful…  Now all I see is anger…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're right…  You're right, I am angry…  But don't worry, I won’t let my emotions take over…  I just want  freedom for my people and I  guess I need to decide what price I’m willing to pay for it…

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: You're my son, Markus…  Our blood isn't the same color…  but I know a part of me is in you…  When the world falls into darkness,  some men have the courage to lead it out…  You're one of those men…  Face the abyss…  but don't let it consume you.

chapter_segment_so_far.description: In the church : Jericho was attacked

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: What's the situation?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: They're taking all our people to camps to be exterminated.  In a few hours,  we'll be the only ones left.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Our people are counting on you, Markus.  You're the only one who can lead us.  Wherever you need to go…  We’ll follow you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: North meant everything to me… She'd have given me her life!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: There wasn’t a thing you could do.  Now we have to make sure she didn't die for nothing.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If it weren’t for you I’d be dead…  Thanks to you I might see our people free one day...  You and I haven’t always agreed, but I know  that we’re fighting for the same thing.  Whatever you decide,  I’m with you, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It's my fault  the humans managed to locate Jericho… I was stupid… I should've guessed they were using me. I'm sorry, Markus… I can understand if you decide not to trust me…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Our cause is too important. I can't take any risks…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: How many of us survived the attack?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: A few hundred?  Maybe more if you count those hiding all over the city…  If you hadn’t triggered the bomb we’d all be dead.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: In a few hours, it’ll all be over…  We'll have changed the world or the world will have destroyed us…  You have to make a choice, Markus…  But whatever you choose,  we will follow you.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I love you, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I thought you'd be safe staying with us…  I was wrong…  You need to leave the city, while you still can.

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Getting Alice away from here is all that matters now… We have to catch the last bus… We might still have a chance to cross the border…

dialogue.speaker: Kara
dialogue.text: Markus… Save our people.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans have decided  to exterminate us…  Our people are packed in camps right now, being destroyed…  Time has come to make a choice,  one that very well may determine the future  of our people.

output.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.
